paragraphs.notes: Tail of the R1 definition of claim 5, which begins on the preceding page (printed page 95) and is cut off there in mid-term after the trailing hyphen of 'Halogen-(C3-C6)-'; this page opens with 'alkinylthio' and completes that term. The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication and not Chinese. Every line break on this page falls immediately after a printed hyphen, so the lines are joined here with no inserted space: 'Halogen-(C3-' + 'C6)-alkinylamino' reads 'Halogen-(C3-C6)-alkinylamino', and likewise for the fifteen other hyphen breaks. All carbon counts on C are printed as true subscripts and are transcribed inline (C1, C2, C3, C6); the same applies to the 2 in every CH2 and to the m and n in -O-(CH2)m-O-(CH2)n-. R2a, R8, R9, R10 and R11 are printed as R with a raised 2a, 8, 9, 10 and 11 and are transcribed inline. Two double spaces are printed and are kept: 'wobei  die' and 'substituiert  sind'. The German prints 'Halogen-' capitalised at the head of each compound term and lower-case '-alkyl' etc. after it; the translation lower-cases 'halo-' throughout, following the convention used for the same list on the preceding pages. 'letztgenannten 15 Reste' is exactly right on this page: the fifteen terms from '2-Tetrahydrofuranyl-oxymethyl' to 'C3-C6-Cycloalkenyl-(C2-C6)-alkinyloxy' count to 15. The German writes 'Cyclo-' as a separate prefixed element in 'C3-C6-Cyclo-(C1-C6)-alkyl' but as one word in 'C3-C6-Cycloalkenyloxy'; both are transcribed as printed. '2-Tetrahydropyran-oxymethyl' is printed without the expected 'yl' on the ring name; transcribed as printed and not corrected. The definition ends with 'bedeutet.', closing claim 5.
